facts.text: Find the dwarves' hoard from the Dwarven mine, which Bral marked on the party's treasure map.
Grimny's ghost said Bral probably hid the hoard in the Dragon's Lair marked on the map. The dwarves had scouted it as a hiding spot: a very small cave of one big room, then empty and unvisited.
The dragon is reported to occupy the Dragon's Lair, where the hoard is probably hidden. This blocks retrieving the hoard. Dunk suspects there is no dragon at all.
Dr. Uriah's Read Languages spell lets him read the writing under one location on the treasure map per day.

What is the last unidentified location marked on the map? Sir Phidipaldi guesses it is King Hogboon's place, and King Hogboon's tribe was found living in the goblin temple ruins near the Dwarven mine.
